verdict.rationale: A buyer could fairly ask whether an agent framework sends user data for model training or offers a training opt-out, so this axis applies. The pack contains no documented data-usage, training opt-out, or privacy-posture statement for ADK. Support for locally running models (google-adk-docs-15) and offline deployment (google-adk-docs-7) is an adjacent workaround, not a training-prevention control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
